title: NCVD toolbox: Nonlinear Characteristic Value Decomposition for Python and MATLAB
description: Nonlinear Characteristic Value Decomposition (NCVD) for Python and MATLAB: exact state-rate modal decomposition, FIR pole correction, ensemble and amplitude-dependent identification of nonlinear systems (backbone curves, frequency-energy dependence), and reduced-order-model diagnostics. Developed at the Nonlinear Dynamics Laboratory, University of Rhode Island. Builds on and replicates Li, Stein and Chelidze, Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing 222 (2025) 111769.
